subject: Re: Evidence request - onboarding & offboarding controls (sample artifacts)
messages:
From: Marta Kovac <marta.kovac@everest-audit.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: SOC2 Intake <soc2-intake@everest-audit.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — onboarding/offboarding control samples

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking this. As part of our SOC 2 scoping for Brightline Health (scope: production services, user data processing), we need a small sample set of artifacts showing how Redwood enforces entrance and exit controls for personnel. Specifically we'd like: 

- A CSV roster for new hires and leavers in the last 12 months (name, role, hire_date, termination_date, access_deactivated_date)
- Redacted background-check results or proof of completion for a sample of 8 people (redact PII)
- Training attendance logs for security & privacy training tied to job roles (Q1 2026 at minimum)
- The current onboarding/offboarding runbook (or the portion that shows deprovisioning steps and owners)

If possible, please bundle these as a single package and include a short manifest that maps each file to the SIG/SOC2 control (e.g., CC-6, PI-2). We aim to complete our sampling by next Friday (May 28).

Also confirm whether any of these artifacts are stored in a restricted S3 path or Google Drive and whether we need a time-limited link. Let me know if you have questions about redaction standards — we can accept hashed identifiers for PII.

Best,
Marta
Senior Auditor | Everest Audit Services

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Marta Kovac <marta.kovac@everest-audit.com>
Cc: SOC2 Intake <soc2-intake@everest-audit.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:02:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — onboarding/offboarding control samples

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items you outlined. Preliminary plan:

- I will prepare a manifest that maps each artifact to the relevant SOC 2 criteria and SIG lines.
- Attachments will be redacted and delivered as a password-protected ZIP for the background checks.
- Roster + training logs will be CSV/PDF exported from our HRIS & LMS.
- Runbook extract (deprovisioning steps + owners) will be a PDF excerpt.

Before I assemble the package I have two quick clarifications:
1) For the sample of 8 people, do you prefer a mix of engineers and non-engineers or just production-facing staff?
2) Is Brightline happy for us to provide a HubSpot ticket link & internal Jira reference, or do you prefer only file artifacts?

I'll loop in Rishi and Laura to pull the exports and confirm retention windows. ETA for first delivery (manifest + roster + runbook excerpt): Wednesday EOD (May 20). Full package including redactions: Friday (May 22).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: initial_manifest_template.csv (stub)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:05:30 -0700

- LMS export: security & privacy training attendance Q1 2026 (CSV + certificates where available)

Rishi — can you coordinate redaction and drop into the Drive folder below with a short manifest linking file -> control?
Laura — can you confirm the retention policy window we should show auditors (HR keeps 7 yrs for hires, 2 yrs for contractors?)
Neha — please provide the HubSpot ticket ID and any related procurement approval notes we typically include for customers like Brightline.

Thanks — KP

Subject: Re: Evidence request — onboarding/offboarding control samples

Marta — attaching the evidence package for Brightline Health sampling. Files included and notes: 

1) onboarding_roster_2024-2026.csv (CSV export from HRIS) — columns: employee_id (hashed), role, hire_date, termination_date, access_deactivated_date. Maps to SIG: HR-01, SOC2 CC6.
2) security-training-attendance_q1-2026.pdf (LMS export) — completion timestamps and cert IDs. Maps to SIG: HR-02, SOC2 CC4.
3) onboarding_offboarding_runbook_v2.3.pdf (excerpt pages 6-9) — shows deprovisioning steps and owners. Maps to SIG: ORG-03.
4) redacted_backgrounds_2026.zip (password-protected) — 8 samples with PII redacted; proof-of-completion pages included. Password was shared with Marta over phone per our standard process. Maps to SIG: HR-03, PI-2.

Manifest attached as initial_manifest_template.csv; HubSpot and Jira references included in the manifest (HubSpot: HS-987654, Jira: SUP-4021). Files uploaded to the secure evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B1redwood-onboarding-evidence

If you need additional samples (e.g., more contractors or specific departments), tell us and we can expand the sample set.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: onboarding_roster_2024-2026.csv; security-training-attendance_q1-2026.pdf; onboarding_offboarding_runbook_v2.3.pdf; redacted_backgrounds_2026.zip; initial_manifest_template.csv
